# Books & Beyond

> Books & Beyond (booksnb.com) is a virtual accounting and auditing firm serving small and mid-sized businesses in the United States, Canada, Australia, the United Kingdom, and Singapore. We pair credentialed, country-specialist accountants with AI-powered workflows to deliver faster month-end closes, cleaner books, and audit-ready output.

## Services

- [Services overview](https://booksnb.com/services): Bookkeeping, Tax, Payroll, Audit Support, and CFO Advisory agents.
- [Pricing](https://booksnb.com/pricing): Starter, Growth, and Enterprise plans, billed monthly with annual billing available on request.

## Coverage

- [United States](https://booksnb.com/us): IRS-compliant bookkeeping, federal and state tax filings, multi-state sales tax, payroll compliance. QuickBooks and Xero supported.
- [Canada](https://booksnb.com/ca): CRA-compliant filings, GST/HST across provinces, T2 corporate returns, payroll. QuickBooks and Wave supported.
- [Australia](https://booksnb.com/au): ATO-registered advisors, BAS lodgement, GST, superannuation, STP-compliant payroll. Xero and MYOB supported.
- [United Kingdom](https://booksnb.com/uk): MTD-ready bookkeeping, VAT, Corporation Tax, Companies House filings, PAYE payroll. Xero and Sage supported.
- [Singapore](https://booksnb.com/sg): IRAS-compliant filing, GST compliance, CPF payroll, ACRA filings and compliance.
